name: web-product-grid-sections-similar-items-and-recently-viewed-on-yellow
title: White product-card rows 'Similar Items You Might Like' and 'Recently Viewed' on a mustard backdrop with hairline progress
whatItIs: A mustard backdrop with a white panel holding two headings and rows of four grey product tiles each with a heart button, name and price with superscript cents, a spec line, green stars and an outlined Add to Cart pill (one filled dark green), with a thin progress line under each row.
whatItMeans: Clear and dependable; consistent tiles and a hairline progress bar make carousels readable.
techniques: Use soft grey tiles for products.
Outline buttons with one filled state.
Add a thin progress line under carousels.

vocabulary.definition: A thin line showing scroll position.
A round wishlist control on a tile.
The active button shown with a solid fill.
